rubric.role_summary: Senior backend and infrastructure engineering role owning production systems, cloud infrastructure, and services for student and teacher product workflows, with occasional full-stack work and technical leadership.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior backend and infrastructure engineering role owning production systems, cloud infrastructure, and services for student and teacher product workflows, with occasional full-stack work and technical leadership.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, or equivalent technical experience.
- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience or equivalent practical experience.
- Strong backend experience; the example backend languages (Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust, Scala) are not individually required.
- Hands-on experience operating production systems and cloud infrastructure.
- Experience designing APIs, working with relational databases, and shipping complex systems.
- Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and reliable deployment practices.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- AWS experience.
- Extensive experience contributing to frontend codebases; React and TypeScript are examples.
- Experience integrating LLM-backed services, including API usage, evaluation, and operational considerations.
- 2+ years of experience mentoring and/or managing junior and mid-level engineers.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California; New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas. Explicit work-attendance terms (city labels use the area interpretation above): We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY and we ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in-person 4 days a week.
